scope: Local manifest-scoped V4 release preflight; no production mutation, provider call, account use or external send

release_manifest.coverage: package metadata, server and browser entry points, every src JavaScript/CSS module, reverse-proxy and service definitions, backup, production E2E, deployment rehearsal and publishing rollback tooling

verification.result: passed 43/43, including complete src coverage, tamper rejection, symlink rejection and isolated deployment rehearsal

required_before_activation: resolve and retain the current production release target
create and independently verify one coherent pre-switch state backup
copy only the 81 manifest artifacts into a new immutable release directory
verify the canonical manifest against that directory before switching
retain the previous release target and stop on any readiness or browser-smoke failure
rollback_inputs.activation_boundary: Switching /opt/openreel/current or restarting the service is process control and remains separately human-gated.

diagnosis_change: The prior production drift is now addressed by an explicit complete source-module manifest and omission regression test, rather than a dirty-worktree copy or another run against the old bundle.
